# Street Fight

> > Street Fight is the leading publication for multi-location brand marketing, agency insights, and local search strategy in an AI-driven world.

Street Fight covers marketing trends, technology innovations, and business strategies for agencies and brands managing multiple locations. The publication focuses on emerging topics like AI visibility, local SEO, franchise expansion, and the evolving marketing technology stack.

## Key Topics

- Multi-location marketing
- Local search optimization
- AI marketing and visibility
- ChatGPT and AI discovery
- Local SEO
- Customer intent
- Franchise expansion
- Retail media networks
- Out-of-home advertising
- Social media strategy
- Marketing attribution
- Brand reputation management
- Agency insights
- Marketing technology stack
- Digital PR

## Core Pages

- [Street Fight Homepage](https://streetfightmag.com): Multi-location marketing news, trends, and industry insights
- [About Street Fight](https://streetfightmag.com/about): About Street Fight: multi-location marketing news and industry publication
- [Advertise with Street Fight](https://streetfightmag.com/streetfight-advertising-for-multi-location-marketing): Street Fight advertising options and media kit for agencies and brands

- [Street Fight Team](https://streetfightmag.com/team): Street Fight editorial team including Ken Burrow and Stephanie Miles

## AI & Marketing Strategy

- [Why Aren't We in ChatGPT?](https://streetfightmag.com/2026/03/17/why-arent-we-in-chatgpt-the-new-question-agencies-must-answer): Agency guide: AI visibility in ChatGPT and Gemini for local search strategy
- [AI is Moving Marketing From Channels to Intent](https://streetfightmag.com/2026/03/13/why-ai-is-forcing-marketing-to-move-from-channels-to-intent): AI reshapes marketing strategy from channels to customer intent-based approach
- [AI Is Rebuilding the Local Marketing Stack](https://streetfightmag.com/2026/03/04/ai-is-rebuilding-the-local-marketing-stack-from-tiktok-to-mail): AI transforms local marketing stack from TikTok to direct mail discovery
- [Digital PR Shapes AI Visibility for MULO Brands](https://streetfightmag.com/2026/03/02/how-digital-pr-shapes-ai-visibility-for-mulo-brands): Digital PR shapes AI visibility and narrative control for multi-location brands

- [Digital Remedy Tackles Ad Measurement](https://streetfightmag.com/2026/03/19/digital-remedy-takes-on-the-biggest-pain-in-ad-performance): Digital Remedy launches Echo platform for unified cross-channel ad measurement
- [Kevel and Adobe Enable Real-Time Retail Media](https://streetfightmag.com/2026/02/25/kevel-integrates-with-adobe-to-enable-real-time-retail-media-activation): Kevel integrates with Adobe for real-time retail media audience activation
- [Review Expectations Reshape Brand Reputation](https://streetfightmag.com/2026/03/09/survey-how-rising-review-expectations-are-reshaping-brand-reputation-strategies): BrightLocal survey reveals rising review expectations and reputation strategy shifts

- [Streaming Ad Platform Is Buying OOH Billboards](https://streetfightmag.com/2026/03/12/why-a-streaming-tv-ad-platform-is-buying-billboards): Vibe.co launches OOH billboard campaign targeting SaaS and AI companies
